method.unit: One scheduled 2026 senior first-team club fixture. Dollar, audience and torrent metrics in the parent study have different units.
method.selection: Frozen before searching the named fixtures. For March, May, July and October in each league, take the earliest and latest regular-season kickoff within seven calendar days starting with that month’s first regular-season fixture. Use US Eastern dates and break ties by home then away name in lexicographic order. MLS adds both Wild Cards, the first Round One game and MLS Cup. NWSL adds the earliest quarterfinal, both semifinals and the championship. Both leagues’ official schedule data independently reproduced the eight regular-season selections in each league.
method.carriers: All eleven played MLS selections list Apple TV in the USA. March 7 and July 16 are league-confirmed simulcasts on TSN and RDS in Canada. The separate July 17 MLS FOX control supplies a U.S. broadcast example. U.S. NWSL carriage spans broadcast, cable and streaming services. Carriage records establish where a match was offered.
method.release_search: Internet Archive Advanced Search across title aliases for both teams, moving-image records, public metadata from the fixture’s Eastern calendar date through November 24, limit 100. A general and an index-targeted web search, followed by two public Torrentela first-page searches per played fixture (up to 50 records each). Resolve candidates by both teams and the event date. Follow matching records to public torrent metadata and compare the SHA-1 of the original bencoded info dictionary with the advertised v1 identifier. Count each fixture once across aliases and listings. The release-note archive srrDB was also searched by league, season and both teams for every played fixture and both controls. For every unpaired date-and-club candidate, check the exact release name against the public Torrentela and YourBittorrent catalog pages and a web search. A technical release note establishes a documented recording and cannot alone verify BitTorrent distribution.
method.ratings_search: Two public search queries per fixture using both teams, date and broadcast measurement terms or outlet. Accept attributable average U.S. match viewership for the fixture. Unpublished figures, weekly league totals, program reach, stadium attendance and highlight plays cannot supply that value. Where a broadcaster publishes a match average without its detailed panel definition, record the limits.
method.swarm_search: The reviewed Alpha60 collection inventory and local filename search identified no MLS or NWSL match-sampling collection. The three confirmed pilot/control identities were also checked against the local swarm metadata JSON and published sports inventory. A listing’s current seed count cannot establish a historical Alpha60 observation.
method.limits: This schedule-based pilot does not estimate release prevalence in either league. It includes two NWSL semifinal telecasts and all U.S. played MLS selections were on Apple TV. A null rating, release or swarm is unresolved in the inspected sources, not a measured zero. The future MLS final is excluded from searched denominators. Both controls are excluded from all primary counts.
method.date: Fixture dates are the local date in US Eastern time. All primary metadata and ratings searches were run on November 24, 2026. The Archive public-date filter uses UTC calendar-day bounds. The endpoints and exact search terms are recorded below.
method.outcomes: Verified metainfo identifies a match video in parsed public BitTorrent metadata. The reported match-length column counts verified torrents with a duration consistent with a complete game in the archived release notes. Coverage from kickoff to full time requires additional footage evidence. Additional torrent listings require a public fixture-specific torrent record but lack parsed metadata. Release-notes-only fixtures have identified recordings with archived technical descriptions and unresolved torrent distribution. Empty audience or historical swarm fields mark no attributable observation in the searches.
method.catalog_search_endpoint: Submit the recorded search term as the q parameter at https://torrentela.com/ with qq=1. Internet Archive Advanced Search uses q for the recorded expression and output=json.
